Definition: a hook (as pointed); also a (large) shield (as if guarding by prickliness); also cold (as piercing)
BiblicalUsage: tsinnâh is the word the Bible uses when it means a large shield. In 1 Samuel 17:7, one bearing a shield went before him, and it appears again in 1 Kings 10:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the great shield of Goliath's spear-bearer shows me how heavy man's armour is beside God's strength.
